title: The Cold Cipher
author: X. M. Oyelaran
blurb: Theo Eriksen, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
